entry_points.text: Compat ptrace picks extended or legacy handling; view follows 64-bit mode; trap records fault and forces signal to user IP, single-step as breakpoint with zero error.
Trampolines save switch normalize flush swap then return or invoke with restore; UART polls readiness, hex formatters emit nibbles, vectors funnel faults to one handler.
Main entry orders traps params memory maps firmware topology timers; hook excludes BIOS/firmware from memory; CMOS/persistent form wallclock; bump extends and reserves.

exports.text: Native halt restart and power operations back public wrappers and a power-off hook; 32-bit PCI fixups, trusted shutdown and a non-returning NMI panic helper complete the surface.
Exposes extended-state software bytes, an Apple platform flag set once at early init, IMA buffer query, legacy port reservation and NX mask sync with CPU capability.
Provides trampoline callback, return-address fixup and prepare step capturing state and redirecting the stack slot to the trampoline.

hazards.text: Config writes mappings and port access need ordering restoration and release or hidden functions stale overrides and broken interrupts/timers result.
Emergency avoids locks via NMI bounded polling ordered CF9 and triple fault; relocation needs identity flush serialization and correct preserve with cleared discard state.
Failed mappings abandon items; low 4K/64K and 640K-1M exclude, vendor 0x8086 IDs 0x0102 0x0112 0x0122 0x0106 0x0116 0x0126 0x010a, pages 0x20050000 0x20110000 0x20130000 0x20138000 0x40004000.
Randomness seeds feed entropy once then payload and length clear to prevent reuse.

invariants.text: Extended peek/poke allow only aligned offsets above segment registers with low-half access; whole-register requests use the 64-bit view, others use generic compat handling.
Clock guard resets on resume; quirks gate on revision, disable interrupt debugging from fabric bits, bind online AMD nodes, force off HPET MSI and enable fragile copy on RAS SKUs.
DMI patterns select forced PCI BIOS or ACPI reboot; emergency virt teardown either uses NMI peer shutdown or is empty, conditioned on crash IPI state.
Measurement appends page-aligned nonempty spans until full then fails fatally; sleep setup scans RAM plus resume vector, with an unsupported build that faults.
Setup drops CET, enables paging/protected mode clearing AC WP TS EM, rebuilds CR4 with PAE/LA57 plus conditional MCE; swapper masks page bases and rotates or copies directly.
Clipping keeps the larger surviving side; firmware intervals clip memory availabilities; kernel segments publish as resources; BIOS ranges reserve and SNB pages exclude.
Boot header yields loader ramdisk and firmware flavour; IMA reserves spans, handover forwards ranges, crash reservation needs enablement plus parse success, NX reports capability.
Prepare saves stack state before redirect; CMOS set validates and get zeroes on invalid RTC; sysctl exposes NMI/boot/delay controls; bump needs live region alignment and zeroing.

locks.text: Fixup scan aborts in interrupt context to avoid unsafe PCI access from emergency paths.
CMOS transfers bracket port selection and data with prefix/suffix serialization against NMI and concurrency.

state_machines.text: Timer force derives or enables then records address/action; board table selects BIOS ACPI EFI PCI or keyboard with EFI guard; emergency cycles ACPI keyboard EFI BIOS CF9 and triple fault.
Trusted shutdown validates enablement and tables, optionally measures S3 with deferral, then records type switches tables calls firmware and halts on return.
After paging work and serialization, no-preserve clears and returns while preserve calls the popped entry; return restores mappings reprocesses and restores state; other faults halt.
Payload walk delegates by kind and clears seeds; reservation protects headers payloads and indirect targets with warnings; initrd reuses mapped range or copies low and frees original.
Bring-up runs traps CPU and mappings before params and reservations, firmware discovery before allocator and full map, then tables interrupts topology timers with deferred crash reserve.

structs.text: 64-bit slots cover general floating extended I/O and shadow stack; 32-bit covers general legacy/extended TLS and I/O; extended area starts at segments with eight debug slots.
Timer override plus resume selector; forced addresses center on FED00000 hex with low bits from capabilities or zero.
Fixups map PCI identities to resets; crash tracks CPU; reboot uses 0x64/0x02/0xfe CF9 0xcf9 0x06/0x0E 0x92 0xCF8/0xCFC 0x44 0x472/0x1234; legacy covers DMA PIC timer keyboard.
Page tags mark destination indirection completion source with mask 0xfffff000 and 1024-word or 512-quadword copies; sixteen debug vectors use uniform stride with zero errors synthesized.
Boot items carry length kind link and payload; measurement and handover carry address-length pairs; ramdisk uses low start bits plus prompt and load bits.
Boot tracks mapped limits parameters and busy image segments; CMOS RTC has port pair plus IRQ and registers when absent; trimming targets memory with BIOS ROM exclusion.
